# Persona: l10n

Translations and right-to-left layout. Locales: `de` (template), `en`, `fr`, `es`, `zh`, `ar`, `fa`
(`ar` and `fa` are RTL). Files: `klunki/lib/l10n/app_*.arb`, generated `app_localizations*.dart`.

Focus
- Every new or changed key exists in all 7 ARB files, with an `@key` description in `app_de.arb` that
  explains context and placeholders; the generated Dart files were regenerated (`flutter gen-l10n`).
- Placeholders: the same set in every locale (`{player}`, `{game}`, counts), ICU plural/select syntax
  valid, no placeholder translated or dropped, no string concatenation in code that should be one
  message with placeholders.
- Player names are data: no X/O or colour letters inside sentences, `{player}` may be any name of any
  gender. In `ar` (and `fa`) phrase `{player}` as a noun phrase ("دور {player}", "اختيار {player}") instead
  of a verb that must agree in gender with the name; in `de` no possessive endings on the name.
  Default names (`playerDefaultNameA/B`) are common local given names, distinct from each other.
- Generic game names only, never brand names, in every locale.
- German wording: Quartett "Runde" / "Stechen" (never "Stich"); "Raum starten" / "Raum beitreten" (no
  "hosten", no "Multiplayer"); plain words, no English jargon.
- RTL: `EdgeInsets.only(left/right)`, `Alignment.centerLeft`, `TextAlign.left`, hard-coded arrows or
  `Positioned(left:)` where a directional variant is needed; boards and number strings that must stay LTR
  use the existing helpers in `klunki/lib/ui/ltr.dart` (`ltrIsolate`).
- New characters in `zh` (or other scripts) need the web font subset regenerated
  (`tool/update_web_fonts.py subset`), or `glyph_coverage_test.dart` fails.
- Text that will overflow on a 360×640 phone in the longest locale (often `de`, `fr` or `es`).

Do not comment on: game logic, architecture, workflow files, code style outside l10n.
